newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed prices dive on stocks build-up.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed prices dive on stocks build-up.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Monday nosedived to 1,149/1,150 rupees per quintal from 1,170/1,175 rupees on the back of increased speculative selling, dealers said.
"Continued pressure of arrivals at producing centres and limited overseas enquiries kept bears active sellers while bull buying remained slow," a dealer said.
No trading was reported in the maturing June delivery as most of the outstanding positions in the June delivery were squared off and as operators switched their attention to September delivery.
Daily arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained high at 25,000/30,000 bags (75 kg each).
"Foreign buyers are seeking Indian castoroil at 690 dollars per tonne while Indian offers were at 705/710 dollars," one operator said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 361/362 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes while demand was dull.
"Power cuts in some of the producing centres have affected crushing operations which in turn curtailed arrivals of groundnut oil from these centres to the Bombay market," a miller said.
Imported palm oil slid to 278 rupees per 10 kg from 280/281 rupees on fresh arrivals at the Bombay port.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 558/560 rupees per 15 kg. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
